Sea operates three market-leading pillars: (1) Shopee, Southeast Asia and Taiwan's largest e-commerce platform featuring integrated logistics (SPX Express) and live shopping (Shopee Live); (2) Monee / SeaMoney (including MariBank in Singapore and SeaBank regionally), providing digital banking, consumer financing (SPayLater), and payment infrastructure; (3) Garena, a global digital entertainment developer (Free Fire); and (4) Sea AI Lab (SAIL), conducting foundational AI/ML research in NLP, computer vision, and decision intelligence.
companies.fit_for_candidate: Strong fit for a founder-side AI systems and operational workflow architect. Satyam's capability to design end-to-end AI pipelines, automate business logic, build testing/eval harnesses, and create internal tools maps directly into Shopee Operations (Cross-Border Operations, Fraud & Risk Operations, Seller Workflow Automation), Sea AI Lab Product Operations, and Internal Tools / Systems Engineering. These functions bridge high-throughput operational problems with AI/software systems.
companies.language_signal: English is the official working and corporate language at Sea, Shopee, and Garena in Singapore. While Mandarin capability is occasionally noted as a plus for specific cross-border e-commerce merchant functions interacting with Greater China suppliers, core engineering, product management, operational architecture, and corporate leadership operate completely in English.
companies.international_hiring_signal: Singapore Headquarters: 1 Fusionopolis Place, #17-10, Galaxis, Singapore 138522. Official Evidence vs. Inference: Sea/Shopee is one of Singapore's most active sponsors of Singapore Employment Passes (EP) for international tech, product, and data professionals. Sea runs the prestigious Sea Global Management Associate Program (MAP) in Singapore across Shopee, Garena, and Finance, as well as Shopee Graduate and Internship tracks. Official hiring pathways exist for international graduates meeting MOM COMPASS standards (qualifying salary threshold S$5,600/month). Unadvertised/restricted: Direct pre-graduation internships in Singapore for non-local university students without Singapore student passes or Work Holiday Pass eligibility cannot be sponsored directly due to MOM immigration guidelines.
likely_job_families: AI Product Operations & Model Evaluation (Sea AI Lab / Shopee AI)

companies.name: Endowus
companies.overview: Endowus (Endowus Pte. Ltd.) is Asia's leading independent digital wealth platform and wealthtech unicorn, headquartered in Singapore and licensed by the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) and the SFC in Hong Kong. Endowus is the first digital advisor in Singapore to span personal savings, private wealth, and public pension schemes (CPF & SRS). Managing over S$7+ billion in client assets, it delivers conflict-free, trailer-fee-rebating wealth advisory, institutional portfolio algorithms (partnering with Dimensional, PIMCO, BlackRock, Bridgewater), and private market / hedge fund access for retail, high-net-worth, and family office clients.
companies.fit_for_candidate: Exceptional high-leverage fit for a founder-side AI systems, product, and operations builder. At Endowus's nimble scale (~150-250 employees), cross-functional builders who can automate compliance workflows, build internal operational tools, integrate AI agent pipelines, and design client-facing data dashboards provide immediate ROI. Satyam's background at C3A Labs in AI evals, agentic workflow automation, and rapid product prototyping directly aligns with Endowus's Platform Operations, Client Technologies, Product Operations, and Automation Systems Engineering.
companies.language_signal: English is the official working and statutory language across Endowus Singapore. Regulatory filings with the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS), investment advisory materials, engineering architecture, product specifications, and company communications are conducted 100% in English. Cantonese/Mandarin is utilized as an auxiliary language for Hong Kong expansion.
companies.international_hiring_signal: Singapore Headquarters: Located in Singapore's Central Business District (18 Robinson Road / Cecil Street area). Official Evidence vs. Inference: Endowus has an international team spanning Singapore, Hong Kong, and India (Hyderabad engineering/QA hub) and sponsors Singapore Employment Passes (EP) for key technical, investment, and operational talent under the MOM COMPASS framework. Internship and junior openings are actively posted in Singapore for Product, Client Experience, and Operations, but primarily target local university students or candidates with valid local work status. Offshore entry-level visa sponsorship requires clearing the MOM EP minimum salary threshold (S$5,600+ monthly). Pre-graduation visa sponsorship for foreign undergraduate interns is not offered.
